headline: The Pakistani rupee closed at 276.70 against the US dollar in the inter-bank market on Wednesday, a gain of Re0.01 from Tuesday's close of 276.71, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Tuesday ke 276.71 ke muqable mein Re0.01 ki behtari.
